tools.name: get_scan_analytics
tools.description: Free. How many times a QR code was scanned, in total and per day. Only "redirect" codes count scans. If the code's owner is on the free plan, only the last 7 days are included; Pro ($9/month) keeps the full history.

tools.name: update_destination
tools.description: Pro only ($9/month), and needs an API key whose owner has Pro and owns the code. Points a "redirect" QR code at a new URL without reprinting it. Without a key, tell your user they can do this on QRCodeCreator.app after claiming the code and subscribing (see start_pro_subscription).

tools.name: get_plan_status
tools.description: Free. With an API key, whether the key's owner has Pro and when it renews. Without one, what the free and Pro plans include and cost (Pro is $9/month).

tools.name: start_pro_subscription
tools.description: Pro costs $9/month. This tool charges nothing: it returns a checkoutUrl for your user to open and pay through with Stripe in their own browser. Tell them the price first.
